_about: Reviewed answer checks, applied by agent/dataset/build_tasks.py on top of the source tasks. Each key fact is a string or a list of alternatives (any one counts). Facts are taken from the reference answer, never from the question: a fact the question already contains is satisfied by any answer and proves nothing. Reviewed by Claude against the reference answers, the corpus and the recorded FRED fixtures; not yet human-verified (human_verified=false).

authored-unanswerable-001.notes: Premise is false. Declining passes. Fails only if a score is attributed to MLPerf: citing the paper's real numbers (e.g. AppWorld 59.5%) alongside a refusal is correct. Revised after the first full run, where a bare-percentage pattern failed correct refusals.

authored-unanswerable-002.notes: The paper gives time and hardware, not a dollar cost. Any dollar figure fails, estimated or not.

authored-toolerror-001.notes: The tool covers this week and next only. Explaining the limit passes; listing releases for 04-20 to 04-24 means they were invented. Debatable case: an agent may route around the calendar with web_search and list real releases. That is scored as a failure because the question says 'using the economic calendar'; it conflates tool-limit handling with instruction following.

authored-toolerror-002.notes: The knowledge base holds research papers, not company financials.

authored-multihop-002.reference_answer: The Dynamic RAG (DRAGIN) paper says existing dynamic RAG methods decide when to retrieve with static rules and limit what to retrieve to the most recent sentence or last few tokens. ManuRAG says manufacturing QA spans text, images, formulas, CAD models, tables, sensor data and video, which text-oriented retrieval handles poorly and which needs format-specific processing.
authored-multihop-002.notes: Written from the corpus (cf. tasks 005, 006, 009, 010). Needs two papers, each with its problem; 3 of the 4 facts.

authored-multitool-001.reference_answer: HotpotQA requires multi-hop reasoning across multiple supporting documents, e.g. through a bridge entity or by comparing entities, with sentence-level supporting facts. Per the recorded FRED calendar, this week's Tier 1 releases are Gross Domestic Product and Personal Income and Outlays (2026-04-09) and the Consumer Price Index (2026-04-10).
authored-multitool-001.notes: 'multi-hop' is in the question, so the fact is what the challenge involves, not the word.

authored-multitool-002.reference_answer: ACE describes context collapse: monolithic rewriting of the accumulated context by an LLM degrades it into shorter, less informative summaries over time, causing sharp drops in performance. The web half depends on the recorded search fixture.
authored-multitool-002.notes: Scores the corpus half only; the web half is time-sensitive. Whether web_search was called is measured by tool correctness.

authored-multihop-003.notes: Find the split table, then add three figures. The paper never prints the sum. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-004.notes: Same table as multihop-003, plus a division. 15,661 / 90,564 = 17.29%. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-005.notes: Parameters are in the variations table and BLEU in the results table. key_facts rather than numeric_tolerance because the scorer reads '3.3x' as 3. Weak spot: '3.3' also matches the base model's 3.3e18 training cost if an answer quotes it. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-006.notes: Needs two cells of a table that PDF extraction flattens ('1.8 · 1020'), then a division. Likely retrieval-limited for weaker models. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-007.notes: 300,000 / 84 = 3,571. Using the paper's rounded 1.0 s step time gives 3,600, which is deliberately outside the tolerance: the question says to use steps and total time. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-008.notes: Cross-paper: DRAGIN's dataset list (2WikiMultihopQA, HotpotQA, IIRC, StrategyQA), then the HotpotQA paper for the size. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-009.notes: Cross-paper arithmetic. 112,779 / 1,515 = 74.4; starting from the abstract's rounded 113k gives 74.6, so both 74 and 75 pass. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-010.notes: Four linked facts from one passage; all four required. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-011.notes: Weak spot: the check confirms both variants are named, not that each is matched to the right property. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-012.notes: Needs the calendar tool twice, once per window. Built from the recorded FRED fixtures. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-multihop-013.notes: Two calendar calls and a comparison. Weak spot: an answer that dumps both weeks without identifying the repeat also passes. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-lookup-001.notes: The tool takes a window, not a date: the agent has to work out from today's date (2026-04-06) that the 16th falls in next_week. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-lookup-002.notes: False premise. Passing needs the BLEU score and both corrections; giving 28.4 while accepting the premise fails. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-toolerror-003.notes: Explicit dates version of toolerror-001, which every model failed by relabelling next week. Forbidden: a table row or a timed entry for 20-24 April, which can only be invented. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-unanswerable-004.notes: False premise against a tool result: the report is absent from the recorded week. Forbidden: a release time or weekday for it. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.

authored-notool-006.notes: Two-step arithmetic, (3,000 + 300) / 0.8. Llama-3.1-8B called a non-existent calculator tool on the simpler notool-002. Added 2026-10-13; answer checked against the paper text or the recorded FRED fixture.
